codex_frozen_pr945_findings: The repeated next token check and the removal of the strategy field aliases and the bounded open incident read are present in frontend b7cd3d847 through FE-MGMT-READS-CORRECTIONS-20261106.
limitations: Pool detail is slow: GET /bff/capital-pools/{id} 13 s and GET /bff/rebalances 14 s and GET /bff/ranking-formulas 13 s and GET /bff/rankings 14 to 22 s measured sequentially with small or empty bodies, so the pool page opens after about 16 s and the strategy tab fills at about 31 s. A shared surface status read of all rankings (1443 rows 21 MB) is the most likely cause and was not proven line by line.
Source ingest job reads hit the 2 s client timeout: job detail returned 503 on 3 of 12 sequential reads with normal latency 1.1 to 2.1 s, and one of 97 list reads in an hour timed out.

One of 6 complete job walks stopped at 200 rows: page 2 returned HTTP 200 with no rows. A job list timeout was logged in that hour and is the likely cause but was not tied to that request; 40 later samples all returned total 1521. The jobs page does not show the degraded surface.
The drawer only hydrates on /management/evidence because that is the only route that marks primary ready, and this predates this work.
The floating assistant button covers the right half of the next page button on jobs and incidents at 1366 and 1600 wide; the center stays clickable.
Evidence reloads ran at load average about 5 and pressure at load 10 or more was not retested on this pair.

Formula overview shows no data for applied to and state and owner and formula while the API returns version and weights and components and basis, so the page is not wired to them; nothing is invented.
